CTRL ACCESS AWARD

This one is for you.

The CTRL Access Award gives selected builders a fully or partially sponsored place at CTRL SF. We want to hear from you — not a perfect essay, not a grown-up answer. Just tell us what you’re excited about.

01 FOR THE BUILDER Please have the student answer these.
One more thing: after you submit, your parent or guardian will receive a short email with a few practical questions to complete the application.
Keep it simple. We are not judging spelling, grammar, coding experience, or how “technical” you sound. We care about curiosity and why you want to be there.
02 PARENT / GUARDIAN CONTACT We’ll email them the follow-up questions.
Your parent or guardian will receive a short follow-up email with a few practical questions, including whether full or partial sponsorship would be most helpful.
